description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Senior Division at the 2009 World Championships, a Flygon lock deck that set out to win by making the opponent run out of cards, a way of playing that had been out of favor for a while. Palkia LV.X brings up a Pokémon to trap, Memory Berry lets Flygon LV.X use Trapinch's Sand Tomb so it can't retreat, and Wind Erosion discards the top card of the opponent's deck between turns; Flygon's Sand Wall removes the opponent's Stadium cards. The 2009 World Championships were held at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront in San Diego, California, in August 2009.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2009 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
